scalars.scalar_value: Experience working as a groundskeeper in an educational or institutional setting.
Experience performing grounds maintenance tasks such as planting and maintenance of vegetation, landscaping duties or pesticide applications.

items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Possession of valid California Qualified Applicator Certificate.
Experience performing grounds maintenance tasks such as planting and maintenance of vegetation, landscaping duties or pesticide applications.
Experience working as a groundskeeper in an educational or institutional setting.
Experience operating a variety of equipment such as mowers, manual transmission vehicles, hand and power tools.

Under general supervision, provide ground maintenance and outdoor custodial services for Campus grounds. Under general supervision, and or following Lead’s guidance, assisting in performing the following tasks: daily sport and recreational field maintenance, game day ﬁeld preparation, seasonal maintenance of sports ﬁelds, irrigation maintenance, repair and modiﬁcation, equipment operations and upkeep within Provide basic service, inspection and maintenance of equipment and assigned tools.
Knowledge of tree, plant and weed identification.

Knowledge of mechanical equipment in order to check for possible problems to avoid damage to equipment prior to starting such as checking gas and oil levels or recognizing mechanical problems which may occur during operation.
Customer service and communication skills to provide courteous service in person and on the telephone.
Interpersonal skills to interact and communicate effectively and professionally with administration, staff, visitors and volunteers, using tact, diplomacy, and good judgment during all interactions.
